name: private-mode-notice
title: Private Mode Notice
description: Notice for private windows, blocked site data or a full quota, based on a real write test before any guess, that offers to export unsaved work and can warn before the tab closes.

meta.summary: Warns before someone relies on drafts or "Remember me" in a browser that won't keep them, after testing that storage really works.
catches: Private window that erases saved data on close
Site data blocked, so nothing can be saved
Storage nearly full, so new saves may fail
Unsaved work at risk: export button
limits: Private-mode detection is sometimes inferred ("likely") when a write succeeds
Export uses the data you pass in exportData
a11y: Notice is a labelled region inside a polite live region
Export and dismiss are buttons; icons are aria-hidden
